items.html: And first there are extended the secret of the Taamim [tastes] of SAG, which are AHP down to his Tabur. And afterwards he did not bring the remaining discernments outward, since they are clothed inside MA and BON, as above — in the manner of the lights of the general AB, of which nothing was revealed except the hairs that are extended from the AB of the general AB, while the rest of their portion is concealed inside the general SAG.
